items.title: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 18
items.description: Kyiv's mayor declares a day of mourning after the major drone and missile attack on the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: People smuggler convicted in France found by BBC living in UK and seeking asylum
items.description: Once described as "the godfather" of French migrant camps, he has been working in a Leicestershire village.

items.title: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
items.description: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.

items.title: China says pilot crashed small plane into skyscraper for 'personal reasons'
items.description: The 66-year-old, who died in the crash, had anxiety and referenced "ending his life" in his diary.

items.title: Aunt of Venezuelan boy pulled from rubble tells BBC she will give him 'mother's warmth'
items.description: Kleiber Moran, 2, was rescued on Wednesday, six days after last week's deadly earthquakes.

items.title: Gaza patients face agonising delays for medical evacuation
items.description: An estimated 300 Palestinians referred for treatment abroad have died since the ceasefire began, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry.

items.title: Did this AI anti-drug video make drugs look appealing?
items.description: Hong Kong’s Correctional Services Department removed an AI-generated K-pop video, after facing backlash that it made substances look too appealing.
